directQuizGuards.reason: Actual explanatory-note/explanation labels overlap; 説明's complete entry also includes legend. Declare all three direct pairs, not transitive protection through another word.

Book-introduction/introductory remarks can overlap broad English answer labels; do not make all prefatory prose or field surveys interchangeable with usage conventions.

Bare English key also denotes a symbol legend. This is English-label ambiguity, not evidence that Japanese かぎ normally denotes a map legend. Both full distinct reading families inspected; no identity change.
